method: source pointer; HTTP GET (curl), cached copy under data/.cache/il26-001 (gitignored)
publisher: Washington Public Disclosure Commission (PDC), Campaign Finance Summary dataset on data.wa.gov
notes: 2026 summary rows for every committee whose registered ballot_number lists IL26-001 and/or IL26-638 (found by searching the dataset for election_year=2026 with ballot_number or filer_name matching 001, 638, HATE, PARENT, GIRLS, SPORT, FAIR, YES, RIGHTS). Main committees: No Hate in WA State (38851, against IL26-001 and IL26-638; contributions 2293942.22, expenditures 821814.18, updated 2026-10-07) and Let's Go Washington (Sponsored by Brian Heywood) (30644, for 'IL26-001, IL26-638, IL26-645'; contributions 3876110.50, expenditures 3613312.13, updated 2026-10-05). No committee registered for only one of the two measures was found. Contribution amounts are committee totals across all measures and activities the committee reports, not amounts spent on these measures.
